name: Badlands Reagent Run
summary: In Kargath, Jarkal Mossmeld needs Badlands reagents to refill his stocks. He offers coin when you bring them to him.

sections.title: Stocking the Shelves
sections.body: Jarkal Mossmeld needs gizzards from five buzzards, fangs from ten crag coyotes, and shards from five rock elementals. Take each from the creatures themselves. If you do not fight, find friends who do. Jarkal pays in coin when you bring him the reagents.

sections.title: After the Haul
sections.body: Jarkal is pleased with what you bring and says it should last a little while. Yet he needs more reagents from deep inside the Uldaman excavation, where gathering them will be difficult. He hints that the pay may be worth more than shiny coins.

faq.q: Who is asking for these reagents?
faq.answer: Jarkal Mossmeld, an alchemist of some note in Kargath, needs reagents to replenish his stocks.
Jarkal needs gizzards from five buzzards, fangs from ten crag coyotes, and shards from five rock elementals. Take them from the creatures themselves.

aliases: where to turn in badlands reagent run
faq.answer: Jarkal Mossmeld is in the outpost of Kargath, in the Badlands.

faq.q: What does Jarkal offer in exchange for the ingredients?
faq.answer: Jarkal offers coin when you bring the reagents to him in Kargath. He pays nothing before then.
